title: The Digital Government (Disclosure of Information) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the list of fuel poverty measures in section 36(3) of the Digital Economy Act 2017 (c. 30) (“the Act”) to include arrangements that are put in place pursuant to requirements imposed by the Gas and Electricity Markets Authority that relate to domestic customers who are in debt in respect of their gas or electricity supply.

summary: These Regulations amend assimilated EU law in the field of aviation safety using powers conferred by Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 of 4 July 2018 on common rules in the field of civil aviation.

title: The Representation of the People (Absent Voting at Local Government Elections) (Scotland) Amendment (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Representation of the People (Absent Voting at Local Government Elections) (Scotland) Regulations 2007.

title: The Community Wealth Building (Scotland) Act 2026 (Commencement) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations appoint 1 October 2026 as the day on which the remaining provisions of the Community Wealth Building (Scotland) Act 2026 (“the Act”) come into force. The Bill for the Act received Royal Assent on 25 March 2026. Sections 12, 13, 14 and 15 came into force the day after Royal Assent.

The Housing Benefit (Earned Income Disregards) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Housing Benefit Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006 (S.R. 2006 No. 405) to extend the sums to be disregarded when calculating the earnings of a person claiming housing benefit (“the claimant”).

The Private Landlord Redress Schemes (Approval and Designation) Regulations 2026
summary: Section 64(2) of the Renters’ Rights Act 2025 (c. 26) (“the Act”) provides that a landlord redress scheme is a scheme which, firstly, provides for a complaint made by or on behalf of a prospective, current or former residential tenant against a private rented sector landlord, who is a member of the scheme to be independently investigated and determined by an independent individual and, secondly, is either approved or designated by the Secretary of State.

summary: These Regulations bring into force section 1(4) to (6) of the Absent Voting (Elections in Scotland and Wales) Act 2025 (c. 27) (“the 2025 Act”), which makes amendments to Schedule 4 to the Representation of the People Act 2000 (c. 2) (“the 2000 Act”). title: The Street Works (Charges for Occupation of the Highway) (No. 2) Order 2026
summary: The requirement to pay charges to an Approved Authority is set out in the Street Works (Charges for Occupation of the Highway) (England) Regulations 2012 (“the 2012 Regulations”) (S.I. 2012/425).

title: The Plant Health, Seeds, Seed Potatoes and Plant Propagating Material (Amendment) (Northern Ireland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made in exercise of the powers conferred by section 8C(1) and (2) of, and paragraph 21 of Schedule 7 to, the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018 (c. 16). The purpose of this instrument is to ensure that legislation governing plant health, seeds, seed potatoes and plant propagating material continues to operate effectively by updating outdated references in the legislation in accordance with the Windsor Framework.

title: Correction Slip
summary: This Order amends the Scottish Local Government Elections Order 2011 (“the 2011 Order”).

title: Correction Slip
summary: This Order amends the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Regulated Activities etc.) (Amendment) Order 2025 (S.I. 2025/859) (“the 2025 Order”), which provides for certain deferred payment credit agreements, also referred to as “buy-now-pay-later” agreements, to become regulated credit agreements within the meaning of article 60B(3) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Regulated Activities) Order 2001 (S.I. 2001/544) (“RAO”).

The Police (Ethics, Conduct and Scrutiny) (Scotland) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 2 and Transitional Provision) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force on 26 November 2026 section 10 of the Police (Ethics, Conduct and Scrutiny) (Scotland) Act 2025 (“the Act”). They also make related transitional provision.

title: The Tertiary Education and Training (Funding and Governance) (Scotland) Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring provisions of the Tertiary Education and Training (Funding and Governance) (Scotland) Act 2026 (“the Act”) into force. The Bill for the Act received Royal Assent on 11 March 2026 and, by virtue of section 39 of the Act, Part 6 (sections 36, 37, 38, 39 and 40) came into force on 12 March 2026.
